sloka: अपेतमाल्यशोभानि असम्मृष्टाजिराणि च ।देवागाराणि शून्यानि न चाभान्ति यथापुरम् ॥२-७१-४०॥
transliteration: apetamālyaśobhāni asammṛṣṭājirāṇi ca ।devāgārāṇi śūnyāni na cābhānti yathāpuram ॥2-71-40॥

translations.english: ﻿ The temples stand devoid of the beauty of floral offerings. The floors of front yards are left unswept and unsmeared. They look deserted, devoid of brightness of the past.
